content: One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains to be done.
author: Marie Curie
story:
Preserved as part of Marie Curie's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of progress and science. Across his life and work, Marie Curie returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
